summary: All six features are implemented and verified: Biomarker Trend Timeline (client-side useMemo over archive, pure SVG chart, conservative direction labels with medical disclaimer), Explainable Risk (real model.feature_importances_ from trained Random Forest, not Gemini-fabricated), What-If Simulator (calls POST /predictions/simulate/ not /predict/, uses actual ML model, no PredictionRecord created, disclaimers present), Emergency QR (EmergencyToken model, public endpoint returns only non-sensitive fields with no email/JWT/password, secrets.token_urlsafe(32) entropy, revoke works), Multilingual + Voice (VoiceExplainer handles speechSynthesis absence gracefully, translation error falls back to original text), Light/Dark Theme (data-theme CSS variables, ThemeContext with localStorage, Sun/Moon toggle in Navbar both desktop and mobile). Django system check: 0 issues. Vite build: success in 1.73s, 0 errors. No new framework dependencies introduced. The only notable deviations from the original spec are the removal of Anthropic/Cohere provider support and recharts from dependencies — both coherent cleanups with no active import sites, but worth calling out against the original spec which listed those providers.
